Proof 1: Master Theorem: T(n) = aT(n/b) + O(n^d) solves to O(n^{max(d, log_b a)})

Statement: Master Theorem: T(n) = aT(n/b) + O(n^d) solves to O(n^{max(d, log_b a)})

Hypotheses: a >= 1, b > 1

Conclusion: T(n) = O(n^{log_b a}) if log_b a > d, else O(n^d log n)

Definitions: recurrence, divide and conquer, complexity
